annotation.summary_en: A man returns home late at night only to discover that an intruder has assaulted his wife, who didn't protest because she thought it was her husband.
annotation.summary_detailed_en: The sketch begins at night in a dark apartment. A man returns home, visibly exhausted and muttering to himself about not waking up his sleeping wife. He is seen in the living room area, at one point wrapped in a shiny gold blanket on a couch, appearing anxious and weary. He eventually enters the bedroom where his wife is sleeping. Suddenly, a commotion occurs involving an intruder. The wife, wearing a nightgown, sits up in bed startled. A tense and gesture-heavy confrontation takes place near an open window. The man is shocked to find out that a stranger has just assaulted his wife twice. When he frantically asks why she didn't scream or make a sound earlier, she provides the absurd punchline: she thought the intruder was her husband, and she only realized something was wrong when the person started for a second time, implying her husband wouldn't have the stamina or inclination to do so.
catchphrases: էս ով էր կնիկ էսի նոր ինձ երկու անգամ բռնաբարեց բա ընչի շուտ ձեն չհանիր ես գիտեի էդ դու ես մինչև որ ինքը երկրորդ անգամ չսկսեց
